## What this is

CCRPG is **two things at once**:

1. An assessment-module-driven developmental RPG with narrative arcs,
   immersive gameplay, and a 64-cell module architecture (8 lines of
   intelligence x 8 stages of consciousness). Every encounter is a
   module executing in one of four modes (calibration, encounter,

   module is a validated developmental exercise that simultaneously
   diagnoses AND heals/evolves the player. The game's progression IS
   the demonstration of integrated growth across all eight lines of
   intelligence.

plan is `UNIFIED-IMPLEMENTATION-PLAN.md` at the repo root.

| # | Decision |
|:-:|---|
| 1 | **Law-of-One layer = canon, fully integrated.** Seven energy rays as first-class types; harvest into 4th density as canonical endgame. |

| 4 | **MVP = modular foundation of everything.** All 8 lines, 8 stages, 7 rays, 4 quadrants registered as modules at MVP launch. Red stage as the first vertical slice. Adding the rest is content drops. |

114: /**
115:  * Render an n-back task: generate a symbol sequence and ask the player
116:  * to identify which positions match the item from n steps back.
117:  */
118: export function renderNBack(task: AssessmentTask): {
119:   prompt: AskUserQuestionParams;
120:   evaluate: (answer: string, startTimeMs: number, endTimeMs: number) => TrialResult;
121: } {
122:   const diff = getDifficulty(task.parameters.stage as string | undefined);
123:   const n = (task.parameters.n as number) ?? diff.nBackN;
124:   const trialCount = (task.parameters.trials as number) ?? diff.nBackTrials;
125:   const symbols = diff.symbolPool;
126: 
127:   // Generate a sequence with guaranteed matches
128:   const sequence: string[] = [];
129:   const matchPositions: number[] = [];
130: 
131:   for (let i = 0; i < trialCount; i++) {
132:     if (i >= n && Math.random() < 0.4) {
133:       sequence.push(sequence[i - n]!);
134:       matchPositions.push(i);
135:     } else {
136:       const sym = symbols[Math.floor(Math.random() * symbols.length)]!;
137:       if (i >= n && sym === sequence[i - n]) {
138:         const alternatives = symbols.filter(s => s !== sequence[i - n]);
139:         sequence.push(alternatives[Math.floor(Math.random() * alternatives.length)]!);
140:       } else {
141:         sequence.push(sym);
142:       }
143:     }
144:   }
145: 
146:   const expectedCount = matchPositions.length;
147: 
148:   const displaySequence = sequence.map((s, i) => `${C.dim}[${i + 1}]${C.reset} ${s}`).join('  ');
149: 
150:   const question = [
151:     `You see a sequence of symbols. Track each one — does it match the symbol from ${n} steps back?`,
152:     ``,
153:     `${displaySequence}`,
154:     ``,
155:     `${C.bold}How many matches did you find?${C.reset}`,
156:   ].join('\n');
157: 
158:   // Build options with drive metadata, then shuffle
159:   const options: DriveOption[] = [
160:     { label: `${expectedCount} matches`, description: `I counted ${expectedCount} matches`, drive: 'agency', polarity: 'neutral', correctnessScore: 1.0 },
161:     { label: `${Math.max(0, expectedCount - 1)} matches`, description: 'I may have missed one', drive: 'communion', polarity: 'neutral', correctnessScore: 0.7 },
162:     { label: `${expectedCount + 1} matches`, description: 'I may have counted an extra', drive: 'eros', polarity: 'neutral', correctnessScore: 0.5 },
163:     { label: `0 matches`, description: 'I found no matching pairs', drive: 'agape', polarity: 'neutral', correctnessScore: 0.0 },
164:   ];
165:   shuffle(options);
166: 
167:   return {
168:     prompt: {
169:       questions: [{
170:         question,
171:         header: 'Working Memory',
172:         options: options.map(o => ({ label: o.label, description: o.description })),
173:         allowWriteIn: true,
174:         multiSelect: false,
175:       }],
176:     },
177:     evaluate: (answer: string, startTimeMs: number, endTimeMs: number): TrialResult => {
178:       const durationMs = endTimeMs - startTimeMs;
179:       const numericMatch = answer.match(/\d+/);
180:       const playerCount = numericMatch ? parseInt(numericMatch[0]!, 10) : -1;
181: 
182:       const error = Math.abs(playerCount - expectedCount);
183:       const accuracy = Math.max(0, 1 - error / Math.max(1, trialCount * 0.5));
184: 
185:       const expectedTime = trialCount * ((task.parameters.stimulusDurationMs as number) ?? 1100) + 2000;
186:       const timeRatio = durationMs / expectedTime;
187:       const responseTime = timeRatio < 0.5 ? 0.9 : timeRatio < 1.5 ? 0.7 : timeRatio < 3 ? 0.5 : 0.3;
188:       const consistency = error === 0 ? 0.95 : error === 1 ? 0.7 : 0.4;
189: 
190:       // Match selected option to its drive metadata
191:       const matchedOpt = options.find(o => answer.toLowerCase().includes(o.label.toLowerCase()));
192: 
193:       return {
194:         taskId: task.id,
195:         timestamp: startTimeMs,
196:         dimensions: { accuracy, response_time: responseTime, consistency },
197:         rawResponse: {
198:           playerCount, expectedCount, sequence: sequence.join(''), matchPositions,
199:           matchedDrive: matchedOpt?.drive ?? null,
200:           matchedPolarity: matchedOpt?.polarity ?? 'neutral',
201:           correctnessScore: matchedOpt?.correctnessScore ?? 0.5,
202:         },
203:         durationMs,
204:       };
205:     },
206:   };
207: }

211: /**
212:  * Render a Stroop task: show a word printed in a different ink color,
213:  * ask the player to name the INK color (not the word).
214:  */
215: export function renderStroop(task: AssessmentTask): {
216:   prompt: AskUserQuestionParams;
217:   evaluate: (answer: string, startTimeMs: number, endTimeMs: number) => TrialResult;
218: } {
219:   const diff = getDifficulty(task.parameters.stage as string | undefined);
220:   const trialCount = (task.parameters.trials as number) ?? diff.stroopTrials;
221:   const colors = diff.stroopColors;
222: 
223:   const trials: { wordIdx: number; inkIdx: number }[] = [];
224:   for (let i = 0; i < trialCount; i++) {
225:     let wordIdx = Math.floor(Math.random() * colors.length);
226:     let inkIdx = Math.floor(Math.random() * colors.length);
227:     while (inkIdx === wordIdx) {
228:       inkIdx = Math.floor(Math.random() * colors.length);
229:     }
230:     trials.push({ wordIdx, inkIdx });
231:   }
232: 
233:   const trialDisplay = trials.map((t, i) => {
234:     const inkColor = colors[t.inkIdx]!;
235:     return `${C.dim}#${i + 1}${C.reset} ${inkColor.render}`;
236:   }).join('   ');
237: 
238:   // Generate the correct sequence
239:   const correctSequence = trials.map(t => colors[t.inkIdx]!.initial).join(',');
240: 
241:   const question = [
242:     `Name the INK COLOR of each word (not the word itself).`,
243:     ``,
244:     `${trialDisplay}`,
245:     ``,
246:     `${C.bold}What is the correct ink color sequence?${C.reset}`,
247:   ].join('\n');
248: 
249:   // Build correct and incorrect options, then shuffle
250:   const incorrectSequences = [
251:     trials.map(t => colors[(t.inkIdx + 1) % colors.length]!.initial).join(','),
252:     trials.map(t => colors[(t.inkIdx + 2) % colors.length]!.initial).join(','),
253:     trials.map(t => colors[t.wordIdx]!.initial).join(','), // Word-color (Stroop error)
254:   ];
255: 
256:   const options: DriveOption[] = [
257:     { label: correctSequence, description: 'Correct sequence', drive: 'agency', polarity: 'neutral', correctnessScore: 1.0 },
258:     { label: incorrectSequences[0]!, description: 'Partial match', drive: 'communion', polarity: 'neutral', correctnessScore: 0.5 },
259:     { label: incorrectSequences[1]!, description: 'Different sequence', drive: 'eros', polarity: 'neutral', correctnessScore: 0.3 },
260:     { label: incorrectSequences[2]!, description: 'Word-based (common error)', drive: 'agape', polarity: 'neutral', correctnessScore: 0.0 },
261:   ];
262:   shuffle(options);
263: 
264:   return {
265:     prompt: {
266:       questions: [{
267:         question,
268:         header: 'Inhibitory Control',
269:         options: options.map(o => ({ label: o.label, description: o.description })),
270:         allowWriteIn: true,
271:         multiSelect: false,
272:       }],
273:     },
274:     evaluate: (answer: string, startTimeMs: number, endTimeMs: number): TrialResult => {
275:       const durationMs = endTimeMs - startTimeMs;
276:       const colorMap: Record<string, number> = { r: 0, red: 0, b: 1, blue: 1, g: 2, green: 2, y: 3, yellow: 3 };
277:       const parts = answer.toLowerCase().split(/[, ]+/).filter(Boolean);
278:       const playerColors = parts.map(p => colorMap[p] ?? -1).filter(c => c >= 0);
279: 
280:       const expected = trials.map(t => t.inkIdx);
281:       let correct = 0;
282:       for (let i = 0; i < Math.min(playerColors.length, expected.length); i++) {
283:         if (playerColors[i] === expected[i]) correct++;
284:       }
285: 
286:       const accuracy = expected.length > 0 ? correct / expected.length : 0;
287:       const expectedTime = trialCount * 2500;
288:       const timeRatio = durationMs / expectedTime;
289:       const responseTime = timeRatio < 0.5 ? 0.9 : timeRatio < 1.5 ? 0.7 : timeRatio < 3 ? 0.5 : 0.3;
290: 
291:       const matchedOpt = options.find(o => answer.toUpperCase().includes(o.label));
292: 
293:       return {
294:         taskId: task.id,
295:         timestamp: startTimeMs,
296:         dimensions: { accuracy, response_time: responseTime, consistency: accuracy },
297:         rawResponse: {
298:           playerColors, expected, correct, total: expected.length,
299:           matchedDrive: matchedOpt?.drive ?? null,
300:           matchedPolarity: matchedOpt?.polarity ?? 'neutral',
301:           correctnessScore: matchedOpt?.correctnessScore ?? 0.5,
302:         },
303:         durationMs,
304:       };
305:     },
306:   };
307: }

468: export function renderPatternPrediction(task: AssessmentTask): {
469:   prompt: AskUserQuestionParams;
470:   evaluate: (answer: string, startTimeMs: number, endTimeMs: number) => TrialResult;

472:   const diff = getDifficulty(task.parameters.stage as string | undefined);
473:   const disks = (task.parameters.disks as number) ?? diff.patternDisks;
474:   const attempts = (task.parameters.attempts as number) ?? diff.patternAttempts;
475: 
476:   const base = Math.floor(Math.random() * 5) + 1;
477:   const step = Math.floor(Math.random() * 3) + 1;
478:   const pattern = Array.from({ length: 4 }, (_, i) => base + step * i);
479:   const nextValue = pattern[3]! + step;
480: 
481:   const question = [
482:     `Observe the pattern of ${disks} elements across ${attempts} steps:`,
483:     ``,
484:     `  ${pattern.map((v, i) => `${C.dim}Step ${i + 1}:${C.reset} ${'█'.repeat(v)} ${v}`).join('\n  ')}`,
485:     ``,
486:     `${C.bold}What is Step 5?${C.reset}`,
487:   ].join('\n');
488: 
489:   const options: DriveOption[] = [
490:     { label: `${nextValue}`, description: `The next value (increasing by ${step})`, drive: 'agency', polarity: 'neutral', correctnessScore: 1.0 },
491:     { label: `${nextValue + step}`, description: `Larger step`, drive: 'communion', polarity: 'neutral', correctnessScore: 0.3 },
492:     { label: `${nextValue - 1}`, description: `Close but not quite`, drive: 'eros', polarity: 'neutral', correctnessScore: 0.5 },
493:     { label: `No pattern`, description: 'I see no clear pattern', drive: 'agape', polarity: 'neutral', correctnessScore: 0.0 },
494:   ];
495:   shuffle(options);
496: 
497:   return {
498:     prompt: {
499:       questions: [{
500:         question,
501:         header: 'Pattern Recognition',
502:         options: options.map(o => ({ label: o.label, description: o.description })),
503:         allowWriteIn: true,
504:         multiSelect: false,
505:       }],
506:     },
507:     evaluate: (answer: string, startTimeMs: number, endTimeMs: number): TrialResult => {
508:       const durationMs = endTimeMs - startTimeMs;
509:       const numericMatch = answer.match(/\d+/);
510:       const playerValue = numericMatch ? parseInt(numericMatch[0]!, 10) : -1;
511: 
512:       const error = Math.abs(playerValue - nextValue);
513:       const accuracy = Math.max(0, 1 - error / Math.max(1, disks));
514: 
515:       const expectedTime = attempts * 3000;
516:       const timeRatio = durationMs / expectedTime;
517:       const responseTime = timeRatio < 0.5 ? 0.9 : timeRatio < 1.5 ? 0.7 : timeRatio < 3 ? 0.5 : 0.3;
518: 
519:       const matchedOpt = options.find(o => answer.includes(o.label));
520: 
521:       return {
522:         taskId: task.id,
523:         timestamp: startTimeMs,
524:         dimensions: {
525:           accuracy,
526:           response_time: responseTime,
527:           complexity_handled: accuracy,
528:           self_correction: error <= 1 ? 0.8 : 0.4,
529:         },
530:         rawResponse: {
531:           pattern, nextValue, playerValue, step,
532:           matchedDrive: matchedOpt?.drive ?? null,
533:           matchedPolarity: matchedOpt?.polarity ?? 'neutral',
534:           correctnessScore: matchedOpt?.correctnessScore ?? 0.5,
535:         },
536:         durationMs,
537:       };
538:     },
539:   };
540: }

2:  * PriorityComputation — weighted priority formula for encounter ranking.
3:  * Spec: foundations/24 §3.2
4:  *
5:  * priority = 0.25 * theta_urgency
6:  *          + 0.20 * shadow_activation
7:  *          + 0.15 * polarity_alignment
8:  *          + 0.15 * transformation_readiness
9:  *          + 0.10 * drive_correction
10:  *          + 0.10 * narrative_coherence
11:  *          + 0.05 * session_fit
12:  */
13: import type { Drive } from '../domain/Drive.js';
14: import type { Significator } from '../domain/Significator.js';
15: import { stageOrdinal } from '../domain/Stage.js';
16: import type { EncounterCandidate, WorldState } from './CandidateGeneration.js';
17: import { computeCellStaleness, DEFAULT_THETA_PARAMS } from './ThetaDecay.js';
18: 
19: export interface SessionContext {
20:   readonly encountersSoFar: number;
21:   readonly sessionDurationMs: number;
22:   readonly targetSessionLength: number; // encounters
23:   readonly recentLines: readonly string[];
24:   readonly estimatedTimeAvailable?: number; // ms
25:   readonly inferredEnergy?: 'high' | 'moderate' | 'low';
26:   readonly patienceSignals?: {
27:     readonly avoidanceRate: number;
28:     readonly responseLatencyTrend: 'decreasing' | 'stable' | 'increasing';
29:     readonly earlyExits: number;
30:   };
31:   readonly forceLine?: string;
32:   readonly forceStage?: string;
33:   readonly forceModality?: string;
34:   readonly transformationState?: { phase: string }; // G.20: transformation phase for crucible detection
35: }
36: 
37: export interface PriorityWeights {
38:   readonly thetaUrgency: number;
39:   readonly shadowActivation: number;
40:   readonly polarityAlignment: number;
41:   readonly transformationReadiness: number;
42:   readonly driveCorrection: number;
43:   readonly narrativeCoherence: number;
44:   readonly sessionFit: number;
45: }

47: export const DEFAULT_WEIGHTS: PriorityWeights = {
48:   thetaUrgency: 0.25,
49:   shadowActivation: 0.20,
50:   polarityAlignment: 0.15,
51:   transformationReadiness: 0.15,
52:   driveCorrection: 0.10,
53:   narrativeCoherence: 0.10,
54:   sessionFit: 0.05,
55: };
56: 
57: export function computePriority(
58:   candidate: EncounterCandidate,
59:   sig: Significator,
60:   world: WorldState,
61:   session: SessionContext,
62:   now: number,
63:   weights: PriorityWeights = DEFAULT_WEIGHTS,
64:   bleedThrough?: readonly string[],
65: ): number {
66:   const t = computeThetaUrgency(candidate, sig, now);
67:   const s = computeShadowActivation(candidate, sig);
68:   const p = computePolarityAlignment(candidate, sig);
69:   const tr = computeTransformationReadiness(candidate, sig);
70:   const d = computeDriveCorrection(candidate, sig, world);
71:   const n = computeNarrativeCoherence(candidate, world);
72:   const sf = computeSessionFit(candidate, session);
73: 
74:   const baseScore = weights.thetaUrgency * t
75:     + weights.shadowActivation * s
76:     + weights.polarityAlignment * p
77:     + weights.transformationReadiness * tr
78:     + weights.driveCorrection * d
79:     + weights.narrativeCoherence * n
80:     + weights.sessionFit * sf;
81: 
82:   // G.21: Bleed-through boost — stale cells get priority boost
83:   const cellKey = `${candidate.line}:${candidate.stage}`;
84:   const bleedBoost = bleedThrough?.includes(cellKey) ? 0.15 : 0;
85: 
86:   const cell = sig.polarity.cells[cellKey];
87:   const traceCount = cell?.traceCount ?? 0;
88:   const noveltyBonus = traceCount === 0 ? 0.25 : Math.max(0, 0.25 - traceCount * 0.03);
89: 
90:   // Developmental need: prioritize lines where the player is weakest
91:   // (lowest altitude relative to the mean across all lines)
92:   const allAlts = Object.values(sig.altitudes).map(stageOrdinal);
93:   const meanAlt = allAlts.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / allAlts.length;
94:   const candidateAlt = stageOrdinal(sig.altitudes[candidate.line] ?? 'Red');
95:   const weaknessBonus = candidateAlt < meanAlt ? 0.15 : 0;
96: 
97:   // Diversity bonus: penalize lines we've already seen recently
98:   const recentLines = session.recentLines;
99:   const diversityBonus = recentLines.includes(candidate.line) ? -0.10 : 0.10;
100: 
101:   // Per-candidate seed based on time + line + modality to prevent identical priorities
102:   const hash = (candidate.line.charCodeAt(0) * 7 + candidate.modality.charCodeAt(0) * 13 + (now % 2000)) % 200;
103:   const tieBreaker = hash / 10000; // max 0.02
104: 
105:   return baseScore + noveltyBonus + weaknessBonus + diversityBonus + bleedBoost + tieBreaker;

113:   const key = `${c.line}:${c.stage}`;
114:   const lastTs = sig.theta.lastEncounter[key] ?? 0;
115:   if (lastTs === 0) return 1; // never visited = max urgency
116:   const decayLevel = computeCellStaleness(lastTs, now, DEFAULT_THETA_PARAMS.halfLife);
117:   return Math.pow(decayLevel, 1.5);
118: }

126:     e => e.resolvedAt === null && e.line === c.line && e.stage === c.stage,
127:   );

129:   let score = Math.min(matching.length * 0.4, 1.0);
130:   if (matching.some(e => e.compoundPartner !== null)) score += 0.3;
131:   return Math.min(score, 1.0);
132: }

137:  * Crystallized → aligned 0.9 / misaligned 0.1
138:  */
139: function computePolarityAlignment(c: EncounterCandidate, sig: Significator): number {
140:   const mode = sig.polarity.master.mode;
141:   if (mode === 'Exploring') return 0.5;
142: 
143:   const key = `${c.line}:${c.stage}`;
144:   const cell = sig.polarity.cells[key];
145:   const candidateTexture = cell?.dominantPattern ?? null;
146:   const dominant = sig.polarity.master.dominantDirection;
147: 
148:   if (mode === 'Crystallizing') {
149:     return candidateTexture !== null && candidateTexture !== dominant ? 0.8 : 0.6;
150:   }

152:   return candidateTexture === dominant ? 0.9 : 0.1;
153: }
